notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Sins of the Floating City — Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/687800/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 is out!
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a while since I lurked around here. I've finally decided to spice up this game a bit, as I've had plenty of free time these past months.

I took a peek at the old posts in the bugs thread and fixed everything I could find. However, if you come across any inconsistencies, glitches, errors, or grammar "horrors," please feel free to report them in that same thread, and I'll look into it.

Testing this version has left me somewhat exhausted (so many changes!) I've updated and added several new textures, sounds, and animations. Most levels have undergone significant improvements with new props, and in some cases, subtle structural adjustments (The Bridge level got a major makeover). So, if your game crashes or something, just hang in there and report your findings. I'll work on patching it up in the coming days.

And now, without further ado, [b] here's a rundown of the changes. [/b] (Potential spoilers if you haven't played the game!)

[h3]New Features: [/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved Resolution Support: 4K, Ultrawide, and any resolution with an aspect ratio lower than 4:1 should properly work. (no more UI scaling issues)
[*]You can now adjust the Field of View (F.O.V) up to 85°.
[*]Sound and Music Settings: Customize your sound and music volume. But please, don't spoil the experience. Try playing with the default settings first!
[*]Frame Rate Control: The maximum non-vsync frame rate is now capped at 120 FPS. Vsync is also activated by default.
[*]Enforce display resolution, frame rate, and vsync settings from a config.ini file. Useful if your monitor's native resolution isn't auto detected.
[*]You can now choose whether the language selector and warning screen appear by adjusting settings in the config.ini file.
[*]Items and notes now display a pickup indicator (white star) when you're near them. No more missing those hidden notes!
[*]Ending sequences now boast color correction, pixelated noise animation, particle effects, God rays, fog, and some transition effects. 
[*]Added a subtle F.O.V. effect when the player is scared or shocked by certain events.
[/list]

[h3]Important Changes: [/h3]
[list]
[*]The old launcher options were removed, as nobody really needs to play the old versions.
[*]Mouse-Look system was remade to make it feel more accurate and pleasant.
[*]The player Camera will no longer jitter when rotating while walking.
[*]Application Render mode changed to borderless Fullscreen (No longer Exclusive Fullscreen).
[*]Ending images and event UIs won't awkwardly stretch anymore to fill the display width.
[*]A few ending images have been retouched to reduce pencil sketch roughness and enhance detail.
[*]The notes inventory menu has been remade, featuring new graphics and better text scaling.
[*]Fixed an extreme number of spelling and grammar "horrors" in both English and Spanish. Many text lines have been rewritten from scratch.
[*]The Shadow capture animation is now more visceral and gruesome.
[*](SPOILER! DON'T READ)[spoiler] The Ethan suicide sequence was remade to make it a bit more dramatic [/spoiler].
[*]Ghosts will now appear only within the camera range (no more ghosts sneaking up from behind). This change may reduce their encounter rate.
[*]Key locked doors now emit a custom sound unique to them.
[*]Added visibly damaged doors to several areas of the game. These doors will never open and can help reduce door guessing. Plus, doors now have a subtle shake animation.
[*]Removed one inventory slot (since it's impossible to fill them all at once).
[*]The Main Menu background image now adapts to three different aspect ratios (to avoid stretching)
[*]"The Shadow" now has a dark trail and some particle effects. (Mwahaha!)
[*]The final puzzle now lasts 10 seconds longer.
[*]The Last City level now takes 10 seconds longer to go dark.
[*]Mall Parking Iron Maze timer now lasts 3 seconds longer.
[*]Some areas now have a floor texture! (Used to be black or plain gray everywhere)
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes: [/h3]
[list]
[*]Particle based Fog (Such as in the "Dark Forest") no longer clips through objects or the map (Depth based blending).
[*]Fixed a bug where The Shadow could capture you while doing the exit level transition.
[*]The collision/trap issue on the Mall Parking stairs has been fixed.
[*]"Apartments" power box side collider missing was fixed.
[*]The Main Menu scene now reflects the changes made in the Hospital lobby level.
[*]Keypads were improved with new sounds and animations.
[*]Shadow laughter frequency decreased in the Torture Chambers (It was getting a bit annoying).
[*]Several spots where stair collisions caused the player to jump have been fixed.
[*]Missing textures and alignment problems in various levels and models have been corrected.
[*]The corridor Hanged-Man in "Apartments" is now slightly more visible at a distance (Changed position).
[*]Fixed Jumpy walls in "The Truth" level corridors.
[*]Added a subtle audio event in the Hospital level.
[*]The warning screen background image now has a maximum stretch limit.
[*]The wire mesh texture was replaced for an improved version.
[*]Added fence poles to several wire meshes in the game. Added frames to several windows.
[*]Subtle texture animations were added to some buttons and props like vending machines, ATMs, phones, etc.
[*]Added a gradient to the ladder sprites.
[*]Fixed a bug where doors would emit an open or close sound at the start of some levels.
[*]Objects such as mountains and distant scenery won't disappear abruptly due to increased culling distance.
[*]Two new hanged-men sprites have been added.
[*]Several textures have been color-corrected to increase the retro/pixelated feel.
[*]A dissolve FX was added to all items and notes when picked up.
[*]The Prison rotary rooms puzzle has been enhanced with new sounds and a new texture.
[*]The Prison wire cut sequence is now animated with particles and new sounds.
[*]Added a subtle interpolation to The Shadow spawn and capture animations in "The Truth" (When walking toward the voices)
[*]Several sounds have been volume-balanced or replaced.
[*]"Sewers" valve puzzle: New sounds and particle effects have been added when using the unpolished valve.
[*]"Subway Station" level exit point was refurnished with a lot of candles. Added smoke the tunnel fire.
[*]The tv controller discard message was removed (Not needed).
[*]"Cell Status" text changed from green to white (As only Red/B&W colors should exist in this universe)
[*][i]And this is dragging longer than it should. [/i]To make it short, all levels now have a lot of new cosmetic features (textures, sounds, animations, props, etc.)
[/list]

Remember to report any issues in the bugs thread so they can be addressed! If you need to reach out, find me on Twitter @earrgames or email earrgames@gmail.com.


Thank you for your patience and enjoy the updated version!
Emmanuel (earrgames)

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 is out! [Minnor bug fixes]
notes.content:
Hello there ;), some minnor inconsistencies found in the latest released version were fixed. As with any patch I release, you can expect one or two random bugs around (Bugs can be very sneaky at times), if you find any weird issue during your plays please report them in the pinned thread in the forums and I'll gladly look over finding a solution.


[b]Version 1.1.1 Changes Log:[/b]
[list]
[*][Added] -The user profile can now be restarted by creating a text file called "deleteprofile.txt" in the "Saves/" folder.

[*][Changed] -The "Agents" are now harder to pass through (As they were in the 2016 version).

[*][Fixed] -Some "watchers" were spawning in mid air in "Dark Forest" level.
[*][Fixed] -The "new content unlocked" message was not displaying correctly.
[*][Fixed] -A visual glitch was showing in the prison yard street floor.
[*][Fixed] -A visual glitch was showing in the torture chambers metal walkways.
[/list]

Take care and thanks for time!

[i]Wishing you all the best,
Emmanuel (earrgames).[/i]

notes.title: Into The Gloom 1.1.0 is OUT! now with Steam Achievements and many fixes.
notes.content:
Hello there guys, the game was finally updated after around 2 years! 

Previously the game was running in Unity Engine V4 which had many limitations about Steamworks integration, it didn't matter how much I fixed it was never going to get the Steamworks features. Feeling a bit guilty about "abandoning" the game and the forums, I decided to try porting it again to newer unity version. As expected, everything was broken, it took me some time to get it back working to what I expect will be the final version of this small horror adventure. The changes can be seen below.

[list]
[*]Engine version changed (Ported from Unity 4 to unity 5)
[*]Added Steam Achievements!
[*]Added Cloud save and local file system [Will no longer save in Windows registry].
[*]Vsync option added. Game no longer capped at 60.
[*]Fixed several grammar mistakes.
[*]Fixed some minor game bugs.
[*]Fixed several cursor related glitches.
[*]Inventory/Dialogs/Menus UI will now scale according to the resolution.
[*]Cutscenes now show the texts faster, but let you skip the dialogs at will.
[*]The scene where you are caught inside the cage can now be skipped (When not the first time).
[*]TV remote control is now much more responsive to user input.
[*]Improved resolution selector; Only compatible monitor resolutions will show now.
[*]Added some emergency exit signs in the parking level.
[*]WASD instructions graphic added to "The nowhere" map.
[*]Small graphic changes in some UI elements.
[*]Player is no longer able to move after being caught by the shadow.
[*]Warning screen can now be skipped.
[/list]

[i]Wishing you all the best,
Emmanuel (earrgames).[/i]

notes.title: Major Update Before the Full Release is Available for Testing
notes.content:
Hello folks,

Into The Gloom now has more content and a lot of new things! Now is the perfect time to try out the game and let us know if you experience any problem while playing because this will be our last Early Access update and hopefully if we don't receive any bug report from you, we will complete the Early Access stage in a few days!

To play the extended edition, you'll need to select "[b]Play Into The Gloom[/b]" on the respective window.

Ready to run for your life?

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[b]New Additions:[/b]

[list]
[*] 9 new maps, featuring new puzzles and choices that may affect the ending
[*] 3 new endings
[*] A new enemy
[*] In-game Notes/Memo System
[*] How to play notes
[*] Unlockable Information about several aspects of the game ("Extra: about the game" text in the menu unlocked at the end was removed)
[*] Unlockable Endings Menu
[*] Pause-like Menu
[*] Optional Volumetric fog mode (can be enabled or disabled)
[*] Mouse sensitivity option
[*] Main menu now has sounds
[*] New resolutions
[/list]

[b]Changes/Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] All maps were reworked with graphical improvements
[*] Endings can be skipped after the first view
[*] New textures and effects
[*] New Footstep sound
[*] Replaced old key config menu
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon:[/b]

[list]
[*] Steam trading cards!
[/list]

notes.title: Update (v 1.0.1)
notes.content:
Thanks for the feedback, I did some fixes/additions to the game:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]A serious bug with the Good Ending was fixed, it's not supposed to say "Thanks for playing" no, it was a coding mistake I did while making the changes for Steam version, I apologize for ruining that moment, if you beat that last level again, you will see the true ending (But update the game).

[*]The key mapping bug got fixed too, now arrows works fine on the setup.
[/list]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 1920x1080 resolution support.
[/list]

Thanks for your support, and sorry for the inconveniences.
Sincerely, Emmanuel.
